identity: A bionic right arm and hand fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are highly resistant to damage.  Due to their size and armored plating, a heavy-duty 1a-style Cyberframe is necessary for operation.

identity:
Inject subject with 10 ml of 09x-"Anaximander" compound
Subject was provided with a standard glowstick and ordered to navigate a three-dimensional maze.  Subject found the exit in three minutes and ten seconds, compared to control who found the exit in ten minutes and forty-five seconds (lacking effective amnestics, we cannot test the subject both with and without Anaximander in the same maze).
Subject was released into the forest nearby and given a ten minute headstart before a team of five trained search-and-rescue personnel were dispatched to locate them.  Subject remained undetected for the full fifteen minutes of the trial and was only found when they returned to base.  When asked how they had evaded the searchers, the subject was unable to answer.  Further testing indicated that the subject had completely lost their voice.
Subject was asked to walk a mile through the woods to a predetermined point, reaching it in twenty-five minutes.  When asked to write down the reason for the slower time, the subject indicated that they had stopped to take frequent rest breaks due to fatigue.
When the serum wore off after approximately nine hours, the subject reported great sensitivity to light, as well as that they had "sweated like a pig in heat."  They underwent a full medical examination the next day, which showed no lasting ill effects.

identity: The Wraitheon Pathfinder is a massive, house-height armored robot.  It is armed to the teeth with a 40mm anti-materiel grenade launcher, a 7.50mm anti-personnel gun, and an electroshock capability to defend against melee strikes.  Manufactured by Wraitheon for the ESCA military, it was used along with infantry thanks to the flexibility of its reverse-jointed legs.

identity: A sealed flask used to transport hazardous and delicate materials.  Of advanced design, it utilizes a miniaturized Riemann barrier to achieve both perfect insulation and containment.  Its currently active, and its contents are completely inaccessible.
